C0965.title: Changing IP Location for 10 Yuan: Low-Cost IP Proxy Services Proliferate
C0965.summary: In June 2022, media reported that sellers on e-commerce platforms were offering foreign IP proxy services for as low as 10 to 20 yuan per month, with some stores recording over 400 sales. These services allow users to arbitrarily change their IP location, providing a cheap and readily available tool for bypassing IP-based bans or blacklist identification.
